facts.value: The Study Service Point and the hotline are your central contact points for questions regarding study, application, and student administration.
The central study advisory service supports you competently with all concerns regarding studying.
The Student Secretariat is your reliable contact point for all questions regarding the organization of your studies.
In the examination offices, you will find contact persons for all formal matters related to your academic performance, such as thesis, exam registration, or certificates.
From application to graduation: Goethe University accompanies international students with comprehensive advisory and service offerings throughout their entire journey.
The PBS offers you support and a listening ear for personal concerns, including online lectures and workshops every semester on topics such as self-reflection, resilience, and stress management.

The PSB supports students with personal and study-related challenges such as anxiety, loneliness, relationship stress, or learning blocks. In addition to individual and couple counseling, there are also group offers.
In addition to a variety of sports offerings, university sports also provide courses and videos on stress management and self-assertion as well as events to get active and make new contacts.

The Career Service supports students and alumni (up to 1 year after graduation) in entering the job market. Strengthen your career competence through workshops, coaching, and networks: free, practice-oriented, and individual.
Goethe University promotes an equitable and discrimination-critical environment and stands for equality, diversity, and inclusion.
Advice in cases of discrimination as well as measures for prevention and reduction of discrimination.
The ombudspersons are your contact persons for problems, complaints, or suggestions for improvement regarding studies and dissertations.
The scholarship service supports students and staff from all departments. Find your scholarship and benefit from individual advisory services!
The Student Welfare Service offers affordable housing near the campus. Discover numerous dormitories, inquire about rental prices, and apply online for your room.
BAföG, scholarships, part-time jobs, or loans – the Student Welfare Service Frankfurt informs about all possibilities of study financing and provides individual advice.
